title: Kuldra Safespot Quick Run - Runescape Dragonwilds
author: beandon
description:
Kuldra is turbo easy with a crossbow. Here is how I like to run it. I am using full dragon armor, amulet of accuracy, and a rune crossbow with rune bolts. Still grinding for that dragon crossbow drop...

This and the entire raid is totally do-able using only a crossbow and various safe spots. I plan to upload a full run showing how I do it. You can also do this in level 8 or even level 7 gear. I will upload videos showing that soon and paste them here in the description. I may even attempt with gear lower than 7. Literally anyone can cheese the raid solo with just a crossbow.

Some things to note:
- I usually activate tempest shield during times where I'm exposed running around the arena. That laser move can easily snipe you if you aren't paying attention so I throw it up just in case. Don't trust the crystals and stuff to block you from it, I've been hit through those countless times. Tempest shield will block 100% of the damage. You can dodge roll as well and avoid it with the I-frames but I just use the shield since it's guaranteed to avoid taking damage.
- The orb dispensers will despawn a dispensed orb if you accidentally activate it instead of picking up the orb first. I have also noticed that pre-dispensed orbs on very rare occasion despawn off the dispenser for no reason. Not sure if it's on a timer or something.
- If you drop an orb on the ground after picking it up with the intention to come back to it, it WILL despawn within seconds. So don't do that.
- Don't mash square(or whatever button based on your console) when using the cannon. If you press square while in the cannon you'll be kicked off it and will have to get another orb to use it again.
- I bring an antifire/super antifire potion to pop during phase 3 just in case. Bring 2 if you aren't confident in your ability to dodge the fire attacks. I also have some sort of antipoison but that isnt as much of an issue.
- I bring 5-10 high healing food. Sandwiches are good and very plentiful in chests during the raid.
- If you don't stand close enough to the edge in the final area during the heart phase then one of those tentacle things will spawn on you periodically. Also, those green orbs are guaranteed to poison you if they hit and you don't have some sort of antipoison. They are pretty easy to dodge, though.

This video is intended for people who are grinding the drops and want a chill low effort way to do this relatively quickly. This is by no means a "speedrun" but I consider it to be the fastest low risk safespottable method. I haven't looked up guides so i'm not claiming that i'm the only one that does it like this, it's just what i've come to through trial and error.
